name: Prevalence of undernourishment (PoU)
transform: first-difference (3yr_avg autocorrelation mitigation; fetcher applies automatically)
notes: SDG 2.1.1 anchor indicator. Item 210041 = 3-year average series (most complete); annual value is 210040 but has gaps. Unit: %. Confirmed from live FS bulk download: Area Code=2 (Afghanistan), Year=2000-2002, Value=45.8. The bulk ZIP is publicly accessible at ~2.1 MB. Country mapping via fao_area_code column in country-m49-map.csv.

name: Prevalence of moderate or severe food insecurity (FIES)
transform: first-difference (3yr_avg autocorrelation mitigation; fetcher applies automatically)
notes: SDG 2.1.2. Item 210091 = 3-year average for total population; annual value is 210090 (sparser). Unit: %. Confirmed from live FS bulk: Area Code=2, Year=2014-2016, Value=45.1. Also available in SDGB domain (item 24002-_T-_T) as annual values from 2014 onward; SDGB version preferred for annual resolution if enough coverage. FS domain preferred for longer historical series.

name: Prevalence of severe food insecurity (FIES)
transform: first-difference (3yr_avg autocorrelation mitigation; fetcher applies automatically)
notes: Sub-indicator of FIES suite. Item 210401 = 3-year average for total population; annual value is 210400. Unit: %. Confirmed from live FS bulk: Area Code=2, Year=2014-2016, Value=14.8. SDGB domain equivalent: item 24003-_T-_T (annual, from 2014). Use FS for longer time series.

name: SDG 2.c.1 Indicator of food price anomalies (IFPA)
notes: IFPA by Food CPI (item code '24025'). Item code is a string with letter suffix. Unit: dimensionless (IFPA score; positive = abnormally high prices, negative = normal/low). Confirmed from live SDGB bulk: Area Code=2, Year=2010, Value=-0.12. Note from SDGB: 'Abnormally high defined as IFPA>=1. Moderately high defined as 0.5<=IFPA<1. Twelve month average of monthly price anomalies'. Element code 6125 (distinguished from the standard 6121 used in FS domain). Item Code column contains the string '24025' not a pure integer — fetcher string-coercion handles this. Per-commodity IFPA (wheat=24024-0111, maize=24024-0112, rice=24024-0113) also available. Food CPI variant (24025) has broadest country coverage and is recommended.

name: SDG 6.4.2 Level of water stress — freshwater withdrawal as % of available freshwater (%)
notes: Item code '24027-_T' is the 'No breakdown' (total economy) water stress level. Unit: %. Confirmed from live SDGB bulk: Area Code=2, Year=2000, Value=54.76, Flag='I' (Estimated). Agriculture-only sub-series: item '24027-A'; industry: '24027-I'. The '24027-_T' total is recommended for QGI as it captures overall freshwater stress. Note: item code is a string with suffix, not a pure integer — fetcher string-coercion handles this correctly. Coverage: ~180 countries, annual from ~2000.

name: Mean surface temperature change on land (degrees C vs 1951-1980 baseline)
notes: CRITICAL: The ET domain does NOT use an 'Item Code' column. Instead the primary dimension is 'Months Code'. The 'Meteorological year' (annual average) is Months Code=7020. The only element in this domain is 7271 (Temperature change). Unit: degrees Celsius. Coverage: 1961-present, ~180 countries. Confirmed from live ET bulk download: all rows have Element Code=7271, Months vary Jan(7001) through Dec(7012) plus seasonal averages and Meteorological year(7020). The fetcher's current extract_indicator() filters on 'Item Code' and 'Element Code' columns — for ET domain the fetcher MUST filter on 'Months Code' instead of 'Item Code'. The bulk download URL full name is 'Environment_Temperature_change_E' (confirmed redirect). Flag='E' on all rows (FAO estimated). Recommend fetcher extension to handle Months-Code-based domains.

name: Cereal imports (metric tonnes)
notes: Item 1944 = 'Cereals' aggregate group (CPC code F1944); confirmed from live TCL ItemCodes file. Element 5610 = Import Quantity (confirmed from TCL Elements CSV). Unit: tonnes. Coverage: annual, ~180 countries, 1961-present. NOTE: The TCL ZIP is 278 MB (uncompressed ~2.4 GB) — this is the largest FAOSTAT bulk download. The fetcher will need significant memory and the Fargate task timeout may need adjustment. Alternative: use element 5622 for Import Value (USD 1000) if volume in tonnes is not required. The TCL domain also includes individual cereal items (wheat=15, maize=56, rice=27, barley=44, etc.) for per-commodity analysis. For QGI purposes item 1944 (aggregate) is appropriate. The fetcher's _FAO_DOMAIN_FULL_NAMES mapping must add: 'TCL': 'Trade_CropsLivestock'.

name: Prevalence of population unable to afford a healthy diet (% population)
notes: CAHD domain covers Cost and Affordability of a Healthy Diet. The fenixservices URL redirects to bulks-faostat.fao.org S3, but the S3 URL returns 403 (access-restricted bulk download as of 2026-06; the file exists but requires a portal session). The fetcher's current HTTP GET approach will receive a 403. Mitigation options: (A) use the fenixservices URL with the existing FAO session cookie mechanism — the URL https://fenixservices.fao.org/faostat/static/bulkdownloads/CostAffordabilityHealthyDiet_CostAffordHD_E_All_Data_(Normalized).zip should work with a browser session; (B) download manually from the FAOSTAT portal and upload to S3; (C) use the FAOSTAT REST API once it recovers from current 521 outage. Item code 23005 = Prevalence of population unable to afford a healthy diet (%); item 23003 = Cost of a healthy diet (PPP$/person/day); item 23006 = Number unable to afford (millions). Element 6121 = Value for all CAHD items. Coverage: ~170 countries, annual from ~2017. Source: FAO SOFI 2022 technical annex; FAOSTAT CAHD domain documentation. Confidence is 'med' because item codes could not be directly verified from a live bulk download (403 on S3) — verification via manual portal download recommended before running pipeline.
